It explains that readers have been disturbed by this story, but that there was no miscommunication between God and Abraham, and that the thought of actually killing Isaac never crossed their minds. Maimonides is mentioned as arguing that the story of the Akedah was meant to demonstrate Abraham's faith and obedience to God.
